description: Mapa Topográfico Integrado. Año 2020-2022. La Palma posterior a erupción is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idecan2.grafcan.es. WMS service. Integrated Topographic Map is made from existing 1:5,000 and 1:1,000 Topographic Maps, which have been merged and updated using two flights: a low flight (digital flight GSD 8.4 cm/pixel, for urban areas) and a high flight (digital flight GSD 20 cm/pixel, for other areas) through the application of field support processes, aerotriangulation, photogrammetric ... Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WMS Integrated Topographic Map. Year 2020-2022. La Palma after eruption" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
